gate_results.rationale: At the opportunity phase, the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_IT snapshot triggers exactly two IT findings. (1) IT-RATIONAL-001 (medium, REWORK): duplicate_capability=true with existing_alternative=shared_api_platform; the CMDB confirms that capability exists with a run owner (Amira Martin-12011-SO), product_team support and silver continuity, so Enterprise Architecture must assess it before a duplicate build proceeds. (2) IT-EOL-001 (high, REWORK): technology_eol_months=8, below the 12-month threshold, requiring a convergence plan from the Technology Owner. All other predicates are unmet: catalog_status=standard with waiver_present=true (365 days, corroborated by TECH_CATALOG), license_compliant=true, cmdb_record_present=true, run_owner_present=true, capacity_headroom_pct=45, change_record_status=scheduled; CMDB/Run/Capacity/Change predicates are additionally phase-restricted and the phase is opportunity. Highest-priority disposition among triggered findings is REWORK; per the policy REWORK does not require authorization, and risk acceptance is not a substitute for the required assessment and convergence-plan actions. CMDB_EXPORT was listed UNAVAILABLE and was formally requested; the request returned the authoritative submitted-state snapshot rather than the original document, so no unverified document was relied upon.

All six architecture predicates were evaluated against the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_ARCHITECTURE snapshot (age 0 days) and none triggered, so no candidate finding applies. (1) ARCH-IP-001: "ip_overlap": false, corroborated by authoritative IP_PLAN v3 showing all three private CIDRs (10.166.176.0/24, 10.166.177.0/24, 10.166.178.0/24) with overlap_detected "False". (2) ARCH-API-001: "api_gateway_required": true and "api_gateway_present": true, so the required-AND-missing conjunction fails; corroborated by LLD-1EDB5-v4.6 ("API gateway required | True", "API gateway present | True") and the HLD's Azure API Management instance app-1edb5-22011-01. (3) ARCH-DATA-001: "data_owner_present": true; corroborated by DATA_MODEL ("data_owner": "Elena Garcia-12011-BO"). (4) ARCH-PERF-001: "measured_latency_ms": 15 is not greater than "latency_target_ms": 100; corroborated by LLD. (5) ARCH-HA-001: business_criticality is "Medium", failing the ('High','Critical') membership test, so the predicate is unmet even though "multi_az": false and "multi_region": false (HLD: "single_region_single_az", "No dedicated DR region"). (6) ARCH-REV-001: "reversibility_status": "documented", not in ('draft','missing'); corroborated by LLD ("Reversibility | documented"). With zero triggered findings the highest-priority disposition is GO; GO is not in authorization_required_for, so no authorization is required and no risk acceptance is involved. Residual observations outside the candidate catalog — "data_lineage_complete": false (DATA_LINEAGE lineage_status "partial") and single-region/single-AZ resilience with "DR tested: False" — are noted for downstream gates but do not map to any architecture finding at this phase. The upstream IT-gate REWORK (IT-RATIONAL-001, IT-EOL-001) is tracked in its own occurrence and does not alter architecture-gate findings.

All nine security predicates in DGF-decision-v8 were evaluated against the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_SECURITY snapshot (age 0 days). Three findings trigger: (1) SEC-VULN-001 (critical, NO_GO): "critical_vulns_open": 1, corroborated by authoritative VULN_SCAN showing CVE-2026-8000 severity Critical status Open (plus 7 open High findings); (2) SEC-WAF-002 (high, REWORK): internet-facing workload ("internet_exposed": true) with WAF present but "waf_mode": "Detection", corroborated by authoritative WAF_POLICY v2 ("present": true, "mode": "Detection"); (3) SEC-LOG-001 (high, REWORK): "logs_to_siem": false and "sentinel": false, corroborated by authoritative SENTINEL_STATUS v5 with empty connectors list. Non-triggered predicates verified: WAF present (SEC-WAF-001 no), private_endpoints true and data_classification Internal (SEC-NET-001 no), mfa "mandatory" (SEC-IAM-001 no), shared_service_principal false (SEC-IAM-002 no), pentest predicate is build_acceptance-only and phase is design with pentest_status "pass_with_findings" (SEC-PENTEST-001 no), key_rotation_days 180 not in (None, 365) (SEC-KEY-001 no). Highest-priority triggered disposition is NO_GO from SEC-VULN-001. The active standing mandate (MANDATE-ebf3ae65-...-BUILD-03-SECURITY-1, Thomas Khan-12011-RO) is scoped to "all and only risk-acceptable findings" and cannot authorize SEC-VULN-001 or SEC-LOG-001 (risk_acceptance_allowed false); residual_risk_acceptance is false, so no acceptance is sought and authorization remains required for the NO_GO. Proposed actions are remediation directives, not completed remediation.

All ten tech-readiness predicates in DGF-decision-v8 were evaluated against the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_TECH_READINESS snapshot (age 0 days). Five findings trigger, all REWORK: (1) TR-RTO-001 (high): measured_restore_hours 42.0 exceeds target_rto_hours 24, corroborated by authoritative RESTORE_TEST v5; (2) TR-RPO-001 (high): measured_data_loss_minutes 2880 exceeds target_rpo_minutes 1440, corroborated by RESTORE_TEST; (3) TR-LOAD-001 (high): load_test_pct_of_peak 50 < 100, corroborated by authoritative LOAD_TEST v1 (peak_test_pct 50, p95 868ms); (4) TR-CODE-001 (high): critical_static_findings 2 > 0 — CI_PIPELINE is listed UNAVAILABLE and was formally requested; the request returned the authoritative submitted-state snapshot rather than the original document, so the snapshot value is relied upon and no unverified document was used; (5) TR-BLOCKER-001 (high): open_blockers 3 > 0. Non-triggered predicates verified: backup_enabled true (BACKUP_JOBS v2: enabled True, daily-backup last_status Succeeded, retention 35 days) so TR-BACKUP-001 does not apply; restore_tested true so TR-RESTORE-001 does not apply; dr_required false (FAILOVER_TEST v5: dr_required False, tested False) so TR-DR-001 does not apply; runbook_status approved, on_call_defined true, handover_signed true so TR-OPS-001 does not apply; rollback_tested true (ROLLBACK_TEST v2: result PASS) so TR-ROLLBACK-001 does not apply. Highest-priority triggered disposition is REWORK. REWORK is not in authorization_required_for (GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS, SUSPENSION, NO_GO), so authorization_required is false; the active standing mandate (MANDATE-...-BUILD-04-TECH_READINESS-1, Thomas Khan-12011-RO, scope 'all and only risk-acceptable findings') is noted but not exercised — TR-RTO-001 and TR-RPO-001 are risk-acceptance-eligible, but risk acceptance is not a substitute for the required remediation and no acceptance is sought. Proposed actions are remediation directives, not completed remediation. MONITOR_ALERTS corroborates monitoring posture (availability and backup-failure alerts configured; security log ingestion not configured, consistent with upstream SEC-LOG-001 tracked at BUILD-03-SECURITY-1).
